newsitem.title: USA: Southern Nat'l to buy Virginia First.
newsitem.headline: Southern Nat'l to buy Virginia First.

text.p: Southern National Corp said Tuesday it will acquire Virginia First Financial Corp in a deal valued at $148.4 million, based on Southern's closing price of $40.63 per share on Monday, May 5.
Southern said the deal, approved by the boards of directors of both companies, will be accounted for as a purchase.

Southern said the deal is valued at $24.38 per share. That is based on its current price of $40.63 and an exchange ratio equivalent to 0.60 of a Southerm common share for each share of Virginia First common stock held.
Southern said each shareholder would receive 30 percent of this value in cash and 70 percent in common stock.
Southern said Virginia First shareholders would receive a maximum of $25 per share and a minimum of $22.50 per share.
Southern said it has an option through the deal to buy Virginia First common shares up to 19.9 percent of shares currently outstanding.
The merger is expected to be completed by year-end.
Southern said it would have about $2 billion in assets and $1.5 billion in deposits in Virginia following this merger.
Virginia First has about $817 million in assets.
